Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy,

Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect 
 electric terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must 
 be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be 
 sure pump must be completely drainage.

العمل المراد تنفيذه
Before Pump Shut Down
تحقق من كمية التفريغ والضغط وقارنهما بقيمة الإعداد.
Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with the setting value, 
 then analyze it and determine what to do ( if it is needed ).

Pump Shut Down
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value.
Check the bolts fixation, then retightens ( if it is needed ).
Check the level and validity of bearing oil and add or change (if it is 
 needed).
Check the mechanical seal for leaking.
Check flanges for leaking.
Check the pump casing against rust and re-paint (if it is needed).
